node.text: Reusable multi-day templates. Starting one copies it into a new workout without changing the template.
Book-guided editable 5/3/1 structure. Review percentages against the edition and template you follow. Main, Supplemental, Assistance, and Optional work remain separate.
Finish or discard the active workout before editing this routine or changing its program position.
Finishing the next workout advances this program. Starting another day out of order uses the current phase but does not advance program progress.
